title: Nourishing Gentle Korean Haricot Beans Stew
description: A comforting and earthy Korean stew featuring haricot beans, perfect for a sick day, with anti-inflammatory properties and a touch of sweetness from candy, this dish is a soothing and nourishing meal option.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 minutes, until softened.
Add the sliced zucchini and cook for 2 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add the soaked and drained haricot beans, korean chili flakes, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, until the beans are tender.
Stir in the chopped candy and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until dissolved.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds if desired.
